title: Require Repository Agent Router Placement
forbids: an admitted package root or direct service module directory without its local AGENTS.md product-context router
why: Every package and every direct service module directory is an intentional documentation boundary, so its operators need a local first hop for product purpose, behavior, interfaces, and navigation without relying on another topology rule or a hand-maintained inventory of today's names.
remediate: Add AGENTS.md at the matched package or direct service-module root and keep its contents within the agent-router source-shape rule. Dotted module directory names remain covered by this documentation law even when another topology rule rejects their source placement.
message: Every package and service-module boundary must expose its local AGENTS.md product-context router.
